extName.message: Exportal — Bridge between Claude.ai/ChatGPT and Claude Code
extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions. Includes the descriptive tagline so the listing matches search queries like 'claude.ai chrome extension', 'chatgpt export', 'claude code'.

extDescription.message: Bridge between Claude.ai/ChatGPT and Claude Code. Export any chat to your VS Code workspace as Markdown, and continue it.
extDescription.description: Short description shown under the extension name in Chrome Web Store search results and the listing card. Max 132 chars.

actionTooltipUnpaired.message: Exportal Companion — click to pair with VS Code
actionTooltipUnpaired.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon when the extension hasn't been paired yet.

actionTooltipPaired.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon after successful pairing.

actionTooltipAuth.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon when the badge shows AUTH (token rejected by VS Code bridge). Hito 32.

actionTooltipOff.message: VS Code not responding — click to retry
actionTooltipOff.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon when the badge shows OFF (bridge unreachable). Hito 32.

actionTooltipOld.message: VS Code Exportal outdated — click to update
actionTooltipOld.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon when the badge shows OLD (VS Code extension older than companion). Hito 32.

actionTooltipErr.message: Last export failed — click for details
actionTooltipErr.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon when the badge shows ERR (bridge accepted the request but rejected the payload). Hito 32.

bannerAuthHeadline.description: Banner shown on the options page when opened with ?reason=auth. Hito 32.

bannerAuthBody.message: The token doesn't match. Paste the right one from VS Code below.
bannerAuthBody.description: Body text for the auth banner.

bannerOffHeadline.description: Banner shown on the options page when opened with ?reason=off. Hito 32.

bannerOffBody.message: The local bridge isn't reachable. Make sure VS Code is open and the Exportal extension is active. The Retry button pings the bridge once.
bannerOffBody.description: Body text for the off banner.

bannerOldHeadline.description: Banner shown on the options page when opened with ?reason=old. Hito 32.

bannerOldBody.message: The companion is newer than the VS Code extension. Update Exportal in the VS Code Marketplace, then retry your export.
bannerOldBody.description: Body text for the old banner.

bannerErrHeadline.description: Banner shown on the options page when opened with ?reason=err. Hito 32.

bannerErrBody.message: VS Code rejected the conversation payload. Check the VS Code notification for the specific cause, then retry from claude.ai or ChatGPT.
bannerErrBody.description: Body text for the err banner.

bannerRetryButton.description: Primary CTA in the off banner — pings the bridge.

bannerOpenInVsCodeButton.description: Secondary CTA in the off banner — opens vscode://...wake to bring VS Code to the foreground.

bannerOpenMarketplaceButton.description: Primary CTA in the old banner — opens the VS Code Marketplace listing for Exportal.

bannerRetryOkHeadline.description: Replaces the off banner headline after a successful Retry ping.

bannerRetryOkBody.message: Bridge is reachable. Try your export again from claude.ai or ChatGPT.
bannerRetryOkBody.description: Replaces the off banner body after a successful Retry ping.

optionsPageTitle.description: Browser tab title for the options page.

chipWaiting.description: Options page header chip — shown when no token is saved and the input is empty.

chipDetected.description: Options page header chip — shown when the input contains a valid 64-hex token but the user hasn't clicked Pair yet.

chipPaired.description: Options page header chip — shown after the token has been saved to chrome.storage.local.

headlineWaiting.message: Paste the token from VS Code
headlineWaiting.description: Options page headline in waiting state.

headlineDetected.description: Options page headline in detected state.

headlinePaired.description: Options page headline in paired state.

subtitleWaiting.message: Copy it from the command palette: Exportal: Show bridge pairing token.
subtitleWaiting.description: Subtitle under the headline in waiting state.

subtitleDetected.message: You pasted it from VS Code. Confirm and you are done.
subtitleDetected.description: Subtitle under the headline in detected state.

subtitlePaired.message: You can now export any claude.ai chat to VS Code with a single click.
subtitlePaired.description: Subtitle under the headline in paired state.

btnPair.description: Primary button label in waiting and detected states.

btnAllConnected.description: Primary button label in paired state — informational, not clickable.

unpairButton.description: Low-contrast text button shown only in paired state to clear the stored token.

tokenLabel.description: Label for the token input field.

tokenPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text inside the token input.

tokenHint.message: Must match exactly the one shown by VS Code. 64 characters in 0-9 and a-f.
tokenHint.description: Hint below the token input — contains markup.

localFirstLead.description: Lead strong-text of the reassurance block at the bottom of the options page.

localFirstBody.message: The bridge runs on 127.0.0.1. Nothing leaves your machine.
localFirstBody.description: Body of the reassurance block — contains a <code> span rendered via innerHTML.

exportSoundLabel.description: Label for the export-sound toggle in the options page settings section.

exportSoundDesc.message: Plays a short chime when an export lands in VS Code. Off here silences the companion only — your system mute and tab mute still apply.
exportSoundDesc.description: Description below the toggle explaining what the sound does and how it interacts with system audio.

testSoundButton.description: Small button next to the toggle that plays the chime once so the user can preview it.

fabAriaLabel.description: Accessible label for the floating action button on claude.ai.

fabTooltip.message: Exportal (Alt+Shift+E export now, Alt+Shift+O official export)
fabTooltip.description: Tooltip on the floating action button.

btnSendNow.description: Primary button inside the floating popover.

btnPrepareOfficial.description: Secondary button — stores the conversation UUID for matching the eventual Takeout ZIP.

btnDownloadJson.description: Secondary button on chatgpt.com — downloads the raw conversation JSON to the user's Downloads folder.

feedbackOfficialPrepared.message: Done — now trigger the official export
feedbackOfficialPrepared.description: Confirmation after the secondary action succeeds.

feedbackJsonDownloaded.description: Confirmation flashed on the secondary button after the JSON file is sent to the browser's download manager.

feedbackError.description: Generic error shown on the button after a failed action.

feedbackSearching.description: Button text while fetching the conversation from claude.ai.

feedbackSending.description: Button text while POSTing to the local bridge.

feedbackOpeningVsCode.description: Button text while waiting for VS Code to launch via the vscode:// URI handler after detecting the bridge is offline.

feedbackOpenedInVsCode.description: Confirmation after a successful inline export.

toastExporting.description: Toast shown when the export was triggered via keyboard shortcut.

toastPairedWithVsCode.description: Toast shown on claude.ai after the auto-pair URL fragment is consumed successfully.

pulseHeadline.description: Headline in the success pulse overlay shown after a successful inline export.

pulseMessagesSuffix.description: Noun following the message count in the success pulse. English uses no pluralization for the mono-style metric line.

errSessionExpired.message: Session expired — sign in to claude.ai

errTimeout.message: Timeout — claude.ai is slow to respond
